opening: I have persistent "sea legs", a feeling as if I'm on a boat.
Since I came back I've had mood swings; I get angry and irritable.
It started about two weeks after I began taking mefloquine, with anxiety and vivid dreams.

opening.text: I've been having persistent 'sea legs', like I'm on a boat, along with recurrent vertigo attacks that last 20 to 30 minutes. Since I came back, I've also been having mood swings and getting angry and irritable. It all started about two weeks after I began taking mefloquine, when I first noticed anxiety and vivid dreams.
